task: Leg 12: V2-a energy balance on a non-empty closed box (lossless slab) with a lossy negative control
input_basis: Slab index 3.5, ppw 40 and duration 260 fs are the leg-3 analytic-slab values (configs/leg3-analytic-cases.json, inherited there from the reference project's A1 canary). The 520 fs case doubles only the duration, to attribute any residual to time truncation or not. Transverse cells 6 is the leg-2 value. The control material is the solver's Lorentz model at its defaults except epsilon_inf = 3.5**2; it is a computational control, not a device material.

invariants.basis: The empty-domain tolerance of leg 2 (float64 roundoff), kept unchanged on purpose: plan.md leg 12 stop condition 2 forbids widening it to pass. A non-empty lossless box that does not reach it is reported with its measured floor.
Passivity bound-violation budget for float64 roundoff, as in leg 2.
Same as slab; this case differs only by doubled duration.
Registered so that the report shows it dropped as unlawful (the box is declared lossy). The negative control re-evaluates it with the lossless claim on an in-memory copy; it must fail.

dropped_invariants.reason: One-way source; no symmetric-source measurement (as in leg 2).
